title: UX rethink pass 2 on /imagine/design/ (the design realm): five sentences, try an alternative layout for real and measure it, make it more visual, check persistence, resolve and land.

set.request: UX rethink pass 2 on /imagine/design/ (the design realm): five sentences, try an alternative layout for real and measure it, make it more visual, check persistence, resolve and land.
set.now: wrote the five sentences after, landing
steps: build + measure an alternative layout on the landing page
ui-test the primary gesture, check console
set.outcome: **Kept the tile wall, made it show instead of tell.** Ten of the twelve study cards on `/imagine/design/` now carry a real screenshot from that study's own `shots/` folder instead of a generic icon (`design.css`'s `.design-shot`, one `preview(nav)` override per child) — the page also got *shorter* doing it (860px -> 786px at 1280, 852px -> 734px at 3440), because a thumbed card drops its two-line description by the framework's own existing rule. The owner's 3-column card was built for real and measured, not just considered: it cost 5-6x the page height (4324px/5280px vs 786px/734px) for the same width and the same three invariants, so it was reverted with the numbers written up. Zero console errors on all 12 children plus the index, at 1280/1600/3440. Persistence: none. UI-test: clicking a card swaps the column in place, proven live.
